rationale: Both greedy stores complete at pre-registered n=32; paired probe called at 56/256 episodes (7 of 32 groups, each COMPLETE at k=8) with mixed_certified_groups=3 >= min_mixed_groups=2. Mixedness is monotone in k (a group with both certified and uncertified members cannot un-mix), so the rl_go criterion was final with certainty; the remaining 200 episodes could only sharpen rate estimates. Called early to release the serve pod for the GRPO slot (coordinator-approved contingency; teardown 12:58Z froze the stores).
